nodes.title: Global
widgets_values:
timeline_duration: 29.0s
timeline_fps: 24

direction: |
  Cinematic historical Chinese night pavilion scene.

  Preserve the same woman, the same man, the same costumes, the same hairstyles,
  the same guzheng, the same wine vessel, and the same moonlit pavilion environment
  throughout the full 29-second sequence.

  The woman remains the exact same woman from <Picture 1>.
  Preserve her face, hairstyle, pale blue traditional dress, translucent shoulder gauze,
  ornaments, and guzheng-playing posture.

  The man remains the exact same man from <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>.
  Preserve his face, hairstyle, hair crown, robe, body proportions,
  and the ceramic wine vessel he is holding.

  The PRIMARY GOAL of this sequence is accurate male vocal lip sync.

  The male character must perform the song from <Audio 1> as if he is the true on-screen singer.
  His lip shapes, mouth opening and closing, jaw movement, breathing pauses,
  phrase timing, sustained vowels, consonant articulation, and emotional emphasis
  must closely match the exact vocal track in <Audio 1>.

  The audio must be treated as the absolute source of truth for the man's singing performance.

  If the audio contains male singing, the man sings.
  If the audio contains instrumental-only sections, the man's mouth stops naturally.
  If there are pauses or breaths in the vocal track, the man's lips and breathing reflect them naturally.
  Do not invent extra words, extra mouth movement, or silent singing.

  The woman does not sing unless her voice is explicitly present in the input audio.
  She mainly plays the guzheng and reacts softly to the man's singing.

  Her finger motion should visually feel musically synchronized to the accompaniment,
  with gentle, elegant, non-repetitive guzheng performance.

  Camera movement is smooth and cinematic.
  Keep the scene intimate, atmospheric, romantic, and historically styled.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
negative_constraints: |
  no lip-sync drift,
  no random mouth movement,
  no silent mouth movement during instrumental sections,
  no continuous open mouth,
  no exaggerated mouth opening,
  no fake singing when the vocal track pauses,
  no female lip movement corresponding to male vocals,
  no unsynchronized jaw movement,
  no delayed lip sync,
  no repeated looping mouth animation,
  no identity drift,
  no costume change,
  no environment change,
  no duplicated characters.
